We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. But we have no structure given. Possibly we need to retrieve IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch? Or carbon NMR? But we need the compound at hand. The system likely has a sample loaded. We can use ir_spectra to see carbonyl stretch peaks (~1700 cm-1). But counting groups may be ambiguous. Better to get carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). Could also use HSQC but not needed.

We need to minimize cost. Probably IR is cheaper? Not sure. Use ir_spectra first.
